text:
ana: quick usability bug from today's lab: when you open the invite drawer and toggle the per-invite SSO switch while typing an email, keyboard focus can jump to the audit breadcrumb. reproducible on Chrome + VO.
kevin: thanks — can you paste repro steps?
ana: steps: Org settings → Members → Invite → type email → set role → toggle 'Require SSO' → press Tab. focus lands on breadcrumb link instead of next control in drawer.
molly: sounds like a re-rendered nav element is stealing focus. probably a stray autofocus or DOM node becoming focusable.
ux-bot: accessibility notes: 1) never programmatically focus non-modal nav updates. 2) keep focus inside drawer (focus-lock) until closed. 3) removed/updated chips must be removed from tab order immediately.
kevin: quick fixes: remove autofocus on breadcrumb updates, add aria-live="polite" to crumb text, ensure focusLock.update() runs after SSO toggle, and when removing a role set tabindex=-1 before DOM removal.
nana: copy suggestion for the toggle helper: "Require SSO for invited users. Learn more." add aria-describedby from the switch to that helper.
molly: design tweak: show a subtle header hint "Esc to close" in the drawer for keyboard discoverability. obey prefers-reduced-motion for chip transitions.
kevin: i'll push a tiny PR with JS + aria changes. molly — can you confirm the helper copy and a Figma slice?
molly: on it.
ci-bot: branch created: fix/invite-ssotoggle-focus-2250 — CI running.
nana: assigning: kevin (eng) for patch, molly (design) for copy + figma, ux-bot for regression once merged. target: patch release next week. thanks!
